task: How many types of Apple Pencil are currently available on the Apple's website? Which one supports Wireless pairing and charging.
answer:
FINAL: Apple’s website offers 4 types of Apple Pencil: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C), Apple Pencil (1st generation), and Apple Pencil (2nd generation). Wireless pairing and charging are supported by Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (2nd generation).

Evidence (checked October 27, 2026): Apple’s shop selection page lists Pro and USB-C and provides purchase links for both older generations: https://www.apple.com/shop/select-apple-pencil . Its comparison marks wireless pairing and charging as supported for Pro and unsupported for USB-C. The 2nd-generation product page confirms that it pairs and charges magnetically on the side of an iPad: https://www.apple.com/shop/product/mxn43am/a/apple-pencil-2nd-generation . The 1st-generation page says it pairs and charges via Lightning: https://www.apple.com/shop/product/myqw3am/a/apple-pencil-1st-generation . Screenshot evidence: final.png.
